findings.evidence: `InvariantForm.lean:100-128` defines `IsInvariantForm` and `invariantForms` under exactly `[CommSemiring k] [Monoid G] [AddCommMonoid V]`, while `InvariantForm.lean:164-179` proves `isInvariantForm_iff_isIntertwiningMap` under `[CommSemiring k] [Group G] [AddCommMonoid V]`; the new declarations at lines 122-149 and 303 use no field-specific operations.
findings.fix: Move these declarations into sections with `[CommSemiring k] [Monoid G] [AddCommMonoid V]`; require `[Group G]` only for the intertwining-map equivalence if needed by the dual-action theorem.
findings.issue: `symmetricInvariantForms`, `alternatingInvariantForms`, and their membership/inclusion lemmas require `[Field k] [Group G] [AddCommGroup V]`, although they only combine `IsInvariantForm` with `IsSymm`/`IsAlt`; the existing `invariantForms` API works over `[CommSemiring k] [Monoid G] [AddCommMonoid V]`. `invariantFormsEquivIntertwiningMapDual` at line 303 is similarly over-restricted to a field and additive group.

summary: The foundational invariant-form API is stated with assumptions substantially stronger than its definitions and proofs require.
